name: Helsinki
limitations: All 31 subpillars are reviewed, not all are measured. Scores require the stated assumptions; unknown evidence remains unknown. This is neither a global ranking nor an exclusion bound. Rejecting a necessary assumption requires reassessment, not automatic retention of its score.

dimensions.rationale: Implemented coastal protection and cooling in priority care facilities support protection; heat, rainfall and slippery winter conditions remain material hazards.
dimensions.assumption: Implemented protection usually works; unreviewed locations and groups do not already face broader unmitigated failure.

dimensions.rationale: National intelligence assessment and local preparedness support mitigation while regional and strategic risks persist; older unmatched events do not establish low current local violence.
dimensions.assumption: Ordinary life is not broadly and persistently blocked; national forecasts do not measure city-level violence and unreviewed strategic scenarios remain open.

dimensions.rationale: Published delivery results, implemented service changes and preparedness exercises support execution; group reach and actual crisis recovery remain incompletely measured.
dimensions.assumption: Observed execution persists and supports usual operation of major services; the reviewed domains are not a complete city-wide performance measurement.

dimensions.rationale: Water monitoring, actual energy delivery and port logistics support usual supply; common electricity dependencies, current backup capacity and household burdens remain unresolved.
dimensions.assumption: Essential resources are usually available and affordable for median-income residents; regional operator evidence does not measure the whole FUA.

dimensions.rationale: Free primary appointments, specified public fees and actual specialist treatment support care pathways; dental delays, voucher conditions and specialist and communication barriers remain constraints.
dimensions.assumption: Necessary care is usually obtainable and clinically adequate; waits and alternative-pathway charges have not become broad unmitigated barriers. Routine clinical outcomes remain unmeasured.

dimensions.rationale: FINGER includes local centres and a two-year randomised human cognitive result; related public services provide a limited translation pathway, without proving current delivery of the full intervention or general resident benefit.
dimensions.assumption: The verified human result and related local services support limited translation readiness. This connection must be challenged; rejecting it leaves LON unresolved rather than automatically assigning 40.

dimensions.rationale: Concrete research, a research-linked commercialisation portfolio, network samples and actual public digital-service adoption support capability; sustained output across the FUA, broad industry adoption and group reach remain incomplete.
dimensions.assumption: Observed research, commercialisation and service adoption persist; evidence from one service domain supports partial diffusion rather than all-industry or whole-resident measurement.

dimensions.rationale: Delivered aviation and international ferries, conditional EU residence and work rights and overseas payment of accrued earnings-related pensions support usable channels; common failures and communications remain unresolved.
dimensions.assumption: Median-income residents usually have usable travel and relocation funds, accounts and communications; legal eligibility does not guarantee jobs, housing or independent transport substitutes.
